Even pain leaves invisible traces.
Emotional fragments that continue to exist within consciousness, transforming over time into memory, energy, and perception.

**The meaning of the artwork**
*"Fragment of Tears"* is born from a reflection on emotional fragility and on the inner transformation generated by the deepest experiences of existence.
The work represents a fragmented reality, where visual matter seems to dissolve into particles, luminous shards, and nuclei suspended in the perceptual space.
These fragments evoke for me emotional traces, inner memories, and states of the soul that continue to live beyond the event that generated them.
The tear is not represented as a simple symbol of suffering, but as an element of transformation.
Every fragment contains a memory, a vibration, a part of the human experience that disintegrates and simultaneously recomposes itself into new inner forms.
I was interested in creating an image suspended between dissolution and rebirth, in which the loss of unity generated new perceptual and emotional possibilities.
The work therefore speaks of the vulnerability of the human being, but also of the capacity of consciousness to transform pain into awareness and inner crossing.
*"Fragment of Tears"* represents the moment in which emotion stops being only a wound and becomes a living trace within the evolutionary path of the being.

**Technique and perception**
Digital work created through chromatic elaborations, visual fragmentations, and perceptual overlaps aimed at creating a fluid structure in continuous transformation.
The fades, luminous interferences, and the disintegration of form contribute to generating a visual space suspended between emotional matter and energetic dimension.
Digital language is used not as a graphic effect, but as a tool to explore inner states, fragmented memories, and transformations of consciousness.
